purpose: Include an unexpected extreme case with even.
keywords: I was so busy I could not even eat lunch.
It is an explanation even children can understand.
I received a letter from someone whose name I do not even know.
restrictions: Highlights an item the listener may have expected to be excluded.
mistake: さえ alone marks an extreme example; さえ〜ば gives a sufficient condition.
